analyzed_vuln.description: SkGlyphRunBuilder::drawText() stores a GlyphRun whose internal run paint is initialized from a temporary paint object created by the looper path in SkCanvas::onDrawText. That temporary paint is destroyed before the GlyphRun is consumed in the same loop, leaving fRunPaint with a dangling SkPathEffect pointer. Later, SkDraw::drawPosText_asPaths copies that stale paint (SkPaint copy ctor refs pathEffect), causing a heap-use-after-free in SkRefCntBase::ref(). Root cause is unsafe lifetime propagation of paint-owned refcounted state into SkGlyphRunBuilder scratch run.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via api_raster_n32_canvas when fuzzed drawText path is selected with paint settings that include a PathEffect (e.g., from fuzz_paint/make_fuzz_patheffect) and text rendering goes through glyph-run temporary shunt to drawPosText_asPaths. Data flow: FuzzCanvas case 45 -> SkCanvas::drawText/onDrawText (LOOPER_BEGIN creates transient looper.paint) -> SkGlyphRunBuilder::drawText stores run paint -> transient paint destroyed -> device->drawGlyphRun uses stored run paint -> SkDraw::drawPosText_asPaths copies paint and refs freed PathEffect, producing UAF.
